mapper.sql: id, order_no, table_no, amount, pay_type, status, item_count, member_phone, username, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, table_no, amount, pay_type, status, item_count, member_phone, username) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{tableNo}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{itemCount}, #{memberPhone}, #{username})
INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, name, price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, product_id, name, price, quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
